slug: 2025-08-26 SADC regional DPI initiative supports KYC, digital ID interoperability across 16 countries
note: Named only as one of the 16 SADC members; the story states nothing specific about this country.

facts.fact: Presidential Despacho 300/26 of 13 August 2026 authorised USD 28 million and opened the public tender for a national digital identity and e-signature platform meant to let citizens and companies electronically verify the identity of their customers, per PTI.
